original_test_intent: Validate DRAM UECC retry handling for each required memory target: prove RecEn[2] is active, observe the prescribed retry attempt and determine whether recovery succeeds or escalates to warm reset/BERT exactly as platform policy defines.
original_method: Correct the list syntax through vendor documentation; map each slot to target tuple; capture BIOS and raw RecCtrl before state; enable UECC Retry and verify only RecEn[2] changes; obtain errortype-2/errormode-0 semantics and expected retry count; inject one target under OOB monitoring; collect controller retry-attempt/success/failure counters and OS/BMC evidence; follow the approved recovered or exhausted/reset branch; restore RecCtrl, injection and BIOS/HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE approves retry/error semantics and target, sets/verifies RecEn[2], runs one injection under OOB control, diagnoses retry outcome or escalation, then restores the raw register and platform configuration.
required_inputs: Authoritative purpose of errortype 2/errormode 0 with UECC Retry enabled
RecCtrl register definition, writable mask, RecEn[2] before/target/restore values and access method
Expected retry count/timing and success versus exhaustion/reset/BERT outcome matrix
Vendor-correct list syntax and tool/spec version/hash/license
Retry counters/registers, UCE/BERT CPER fields, boot deadlines, abort/OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up ECC SUT with OOB console and known-good boot/reimage path
Record full RecCtrl value and writable-mask plan before changing RecEn[2]; do not clobber adjacent bits
Inject once on one mapped target and capture retry counters before any reset
Abort on wrong target, unexpected retry loop, error storm, fatal escalation, boot failure or persistent UECC
No automatic retry/recovery; disable injection and restore/diff RecCtrl, BIOS and HDT state
agent_execution_scope: Validate register definition, tool flags, topology, retry outcome matrix and recovery plan
Collect read-only raw register/counter, tool, console, OS/BERT/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not set RecEn[2], choose tuple/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve RecEn[2] change and retry semantics
Restore raw register/configuration and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify raw RecEn[2], run one mapped UECC stimulus, measure retry attempt/result and follow a deterministic recovery-versus-escalation branch with exact restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds register masking, retry counters/timing, branch-specific oracle, decoded BERT correlation and raw-state rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS or BERT alone cannot show that UECC retry was attempted or worked as intended.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect register write or retry semantics can create repeated errors, mask a UCE, force reset or leave unstable memory state.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The generic Parity title does not say what UECC Retry behavior is under test. Criteria mixes CE PASS with UCE warm-reset/BERT but defines neither retry success nor exhaustion. Errortype 2 semantics are absent, list syntax is malformed, fixed tuple cannot prove slot 1~N, and timeout/reset timing is undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: UECC retry with RecEn[2] and an errortype-2 stimulus is identifiable. Engineering can define retry outcomes, flags and target, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 54 Wistron-System RAS-00774-V003: define errortype=2/errormode=0 stimulus and the UECC Retry purpose; provide RecCtrl/RecEn[2] register definition, before/target/restore values, retry count/timing and deterministic recovered-versus-exhausted/reset/BERT matrix; correct list syntax; provide slot-to-UMC coverage and approve/correct 0:0:3; approve tool/spec provenance, exact retry/BERT evidence, boot deadlines, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes UECC retry itself observable through raw register and retry counters, replacing ambiguous CE/UCE wording with branch-specific recovery or escalation evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Enabling RecEn[2] is only a precondition; the test must show a retry attempt and whether it corrected the read or exhausted policy. A final BERT record after reset proves persistence of an error report, not that retry operated correctly. Conversely, no reset could be expected success rather than missing injection. Therefore the owner must define both branches, the retry count and the exact raw register rollback before a single stimulus.
